items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: when Mike Whiteman got finished playing Concerto O'NF by Gershwin

ctx.x: Well, I think it was probably one of the most exciting things that I can remember happening in my musical career. I don't know of any, I've had quite a few nice things happen, but this probably had to be one of the most exciting because, as I say, Bix was, well, it was a magic word at that time. And when we found out that Paul Whiteman was going to tour down this way and he was going to be at the St. Charles Theater, which is no longer here now, they tour it now. Why? This was something that everybody just looked…

come out there too. So we went back into the theater and when Mike Whiteman got finished playing Concerto O'NF by Gershwin, he put his baton on and he says, well, he says, all I can say is now, he says, I think I better turn it over to Bix and let him take over. He says, oh, they're going to tear this place down.
Do you remember what they, what did they do?
